The hotel offers an impressive range of facilities and the highest level of luxury through…

name: ibis Sfax
desc: ibis Sfax features 187 non-smoking rooms. The hotel features various services and amenities, including a main restaurant with buffet breakfast, light snacks, pastries and hot meals, as well as two bars. The hotel offers a fitness center with full equipment and an outdoor pool on the first floor. ibis Sfax offers 5 meeting rooms, making it perfect for business gatherings.

desc: Situated in the heart of Tunis's Les Berges du Lac district, close to many embassies and multi-national companies. 10 minutes from the International Airport (TUN) and 15 minutes to downtown Tunis. Its central location is extremely convenient for business stays, and leisure destinations are easily accessible. Visit nearby shopping malls with ease and explore cultural landmarks, such as Carthage or the Tunis Medina…

name: Novotel Tunis
desc: The 4-star Novotel Tunis hotel is a modern complex of 126 air-conditioned rooms. The Novotel bar and restaurant is great for breakfast, dinner or a foodie treat, and combines a healthy menu with 24-hour à la carte service. Try the Sky Lounge on the 8th floor for a breathtaking view of Tunis. Relax in the fitness room or spa with hammam. Business guests will also appreciate our banquet area.

Our hotel invites you to share moments of relaxation and conviviality, whether lounging by the pool under the sun or indulging in our wellness area with service attentive to you.
